legal.data_processing_subtitle: How we process inquiries, orders, and AI-assisted features on this platform.
legal.data_processing_scope_body: Business contact details, company information, shipping and billing data, product selections, RFQ content, and documents you upload (e.g. specifications, payment proofs, KYB materials) are processed to operate the B2B OEM relationship: quotes, orders, compliance checks, logistics, and customer support.
legal.data_processing_ai_body: Where AI features are enabled, your text may be sent to configured model providers to generate summaries, suggestions, or search results. Outputs are informational only and do not replace professional legal, regulatory, or customs advice. You can disable public AI routes server-side via DISABLE_PUBLIC_AI_ROUTES.
legal.data_processing_retention_body: Retention periods follow operational and accounting needs and applicable law. Technical and organizational measures are applied as described in our Privacy Policy.
legal.data_processing_contact_body: Contact us using the details in the Privacy Policy for data-related requests.

privacy.intro: Welcome to CandyPro. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy.data_collect_desc: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
privacy.identity_data: Identity Data includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier.
privacy.contact_data: Contact Data includes billing address, delivery address, email address and telephone numbers.
privacy.use_data_desc: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
privacy.use_contract: Where we need to perform the contract we are about to enter into or have entered into with you.
privacy.use_legitimate: Where it is necessary for our legitimate interests (or those of a third party) and your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests.
privacy.use_legal: Where we need to comply with a legal obligation.
privacy.data_retention_desc: We will only retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes we collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements. To determine the appropriate retention period, we consider the amount, nature, and sensitivity of the personal data, the potential risk of harm from unauthorised use or disclosure, the purposes for which we process it, and whether we can achieve those purposes through other means, and the applicable legal requirements.
privacy.third_party_desc: We may share your personal data with the following parties: IT service providers (cloud hosting, email services), logistics and shipping providers for order fulfilment, payment processors and financial institutions, compliance and KYB verification service providers, AI model providers (when AI features are used), and legal and professional advisors where necessary. We require all third parties to respect the security of your personal data and to process it in accordance with the law. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.user_rights_desc: Under applicable data protection laws, you may have the following rights:
privacy.user_rights_access: Right of Access: Request access to your personal data.
privacy.user_rights_correction: Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate personal data.
privacy.user_rights_deletion: Right to Erasure: Request erasure of your personal data ('right to be forgotten').
privacy.user_rights_portability: Right to Data Portability: Request transfer of your data to a third party.
privacy.user_rights_restriction: Right to Restrict Processing: Request restriction of processing of your personal data.
privacy.user_rights_objection: Right to Object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing.
privacy.cross_border_desc: Your personal data may be transferred to — and maintained on — computers located outside of your jurisdiction where data protection laws may differ. When we do so, we ensure appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or adequacy decisions are in place to protect your data.
privacy.cookies_desc: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies. Essential cookies are required for the website to operate. Analytics and functional cookies are only used with your consent. Please review our Cookie Policy for detailed information on how to manage your cookie preferences.
privacy.dpo_contact_desc: For purposes of GDPR and other applicable privacy law compliance, our Data Protection Officer can be reached at: dpo{'@'}candypro.com. For urgent inquiries, please use the subject line Data Privacy in your email.
privacy.children_desc: Our services are intended for B2B business professionals and are not directed to children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.changes_desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the 'Last Updated' date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.

legal.cookie_intro: This Cookie Policy explains how CandyPro uses cookies and similar technologies on our website.
legal.cookie_what_desc: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device by websites when you visit them. They are widely used to make websites work, or work more efficiently, as well as to provide information to the website owners.
legal.cookie_essential_desc: These are necessary for the website to operate and cannot be switched off. They are usually set in response to actions you take, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in, or filling in forms.
legal.cookie_functional_desc: These enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization, such as language preferences and remembering items in your cart. They may be set by us or by third-party providers.
legal.cookie_analytics_desc: These help us understand how visitors interact with the website by collecting and reporting information anonymously. We only use these with your consent.
legal.cookie_marketing_desc: These may be set through our website by our advertising partners. They may be used to build a profile of your interests and show relevant advertisements. We do not currently use marketing cookies.
legal.cookie_manage_desc: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time by clicking the 'Cookie Settings' button in our website footer. You can also set your browser to refuse cookies; however, some website features may not function properly.
legal.cookie_third_party_desc: Some third-party providers we work with (including analytics providers) may use their own cookies. We do not have control over the placement of third-party cookies. Please review their respective privacy policies for details.
legal.cookie_consent_desc: On your first visit, we ask for your consent to non-essential cookies via a consent banner. You can change your preferences at any time. By continuing to use our website with knowledge of this policy, you consent to our use of cookies as described.
legal.translation_disclaimer_intro: This website's content is provided in multiple languages for your convenience. Please read the following disclaimer carefully.
legal.translation_accuracy_desc: Translations on this website are provided for informational purposes only. While we make reasonable efforts to provide accurate translations, we cannot guarantee that any translation will be accurate, complete, or current. Machine and human translations may not capture the nuance of legal, technical, or regulatory terminology.
legal.translation_authoritative_desc: In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between the Chinese (Simplified) version and any other language version of any page or document on this website, including without limitation legal policies, terms of service, product descriptions, and contract materials, the Chinese version shall prevail. The English text is for international reference purposes. Other translated texts are not intended to be legally binding or officially certified and are provided only as a convenience service.
legal.translation_legal_effect_desc: Translated versions of legal documents and policies do not constitute legal offers or contracts. For any legal or contractual matter, please refer to the original Chinese version or contact our legal counsel. In cross-border business dealings, both parties are responsible for ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations.
legal.returns_intro: This B2B return and refund policy applies to all orders placed through CandyPro. Please review carefully before placing an order.
legal.returns_conditions_desc: Due to the made-to-order nature of confectionery products, returns are only accepted under the following circumstances: (a) Significant manufacturing defects that affect product safety or essential quality; (b) Wrong product specifications compared to the agreed contract; (c) Goods damaged during transit where shipping was arranged by CandyPro. All quality issues must be reported within 7 days of receipt.
legal.returns_timeframe_desc: Return requests must be submitted in writing within 7 calendar days from the date the shipment is delivered. Returned goods must be shipped within 14 days after return authorization. Requests made after 7 days will not be accepted without exceptional circumstances.
legal.returns_process_desc: (1) Notify your account team with photographs and detailed descriptions of the issue; (2) Our quality team will review the claim and may request samples or additional documentation; (3) Upon approval, we will issue a Return Material Authorization (RMA) number and shipping instructions; (4) Returns without RMA are not accepted. Goods should be returned in original packaging and in resalable condition where possible.
legal.returns_refund_desc: Upon receipt and inspection, refunds may be issued as: (a) Replacement or re-manufacture of defective goods (at our discretion); (b) Credit note for future orders; (c) Monetary refund to the original method of payment, typically processed within 30 days. Refund method is determined on a case-by-case basis. Cash refunds may not be available for accounts with trade credit.
legal.returns_exceptions_desc: The following are not returnable: (a) Custom-formulated products with customer-specific formulations, branding, or packaging unless defective; (b) Products that have been opened or partially consumed after delivery; (c) Products incorrectly stored by the buyer; (d) Perishable goods that have expired due to transit time or buyer-controlled delays.
legal.returns_shipping_desc: For approved returns due to CandyPro error (defect, wrong specification), we will arrange and pay for return shipping. For all other approved returns, the buyer bears the return shipping costs. A trackable shipping method is recommended for all returns.
legal.shipping_intro: This shipping policy explains how B2B international shipping works for CandyPro orders.
legal.shipping_methods_desc: We offer multiple shipping options depending on your destination and order size: (a) Sea Freight — economical for high-volume orders; (b) Air Freight — faster for medium-sized shipments; (c) Courier (DHL, FedEx, UPS) — for samples and small orders. Estimated transit times are provided by our sales team in your order confirmation — this website does not publish fixed delivery windows.
legal.shipping_incoterms_desc: Shipping follows the Incoterms agreed on each order. By default, unless otherwise agreed, FOB (Shanghai Port) applies: CandyPro arranges and pays for transportation to the export port; the buyer bears the sea/air freight, insurance, import customs clearance, duties, and taxes in the destination country. Alternative terms (CIF, DAP) are available on request and may affect pricing.
legal.shipping_customs_desc: The buyer is responsible for all import customs clearance procedures, duties, taxes, and customs broker fees in the destination country. CandyPro provides standard export documents (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading). Additional documents (Certificate of Origin, Health Certificate, Halal Certificate) are available on request and may incur extra charges. CandyPro is not responsible for delays caused by customs inspections.
legal.shipping_timeline_desc: Production and delivery schedules are estimated by our sales team for each order. Specific timelines (production and transit) are stated only in your order confirmation — not as fixed promises on this website.
legal.shipping_insurance_desc: We strongly recommend all buyers arrange shipping insurance. Unless otherwise requested in writing, shipping insurance is the buyer's responsibility. CandyPro offers shipping insurance as an optional service on request. Any claims for goods lost or damaged during transit must be filed by the buyer directly with the carrier unless shipping and insurance were arranged by CandyPro.
legal.shipping_restrictions_desc: We reserve the right to refuse or restrict shipments to certain destinations based on applicable international sanctions, export controls, or internal risk assessments. Buyers are responsible for ensuring that ordered products can be legally imported into their destination country and comply with all local food safety regulations and labeling requirements.

legal.impressum_representative_desc: Managing Director updated upon request. For shareholder/director information, please contact corporate legal.
legal.impressum_register_desc: Registered with the Shanghai Municipal Market Regulation Administration. Commercial registration number available upon request through official contact channels.
legal.impressum_vat_desc: Unified VAT number available upon request for legitimate customers and business transactions. For tax compliance information, please direct inquiries to legal{'@'}candypro.com.
legal.impressum_disclaimer_desc: Despite careful content control, we assume no liability for the content of external links. The operators of the linked pages are solely responsible for their content. The content of this website is provided for business informational purposes and does not constitute legal advice.
legal.jurisdiction_notice_desc: CandyPro products are sold across multiple jurisdictions with differing regulatory requirements. Product labeling requirements, ingredient lists, nutritional claims, and import compliance requirements may vary by destination country. It is the buyer's responsibility to verify that all ordered products meet the applicable legal and regulatory requirements of their destination country. Please consult a local regulatory advisor or contact our compliance team for destination-specific guidance.
legal.food_compliance_desc: CandyPro manufactures products in HACCP, ISO22000, BRC certified, and Halal-certified facilities. However, regulatory requirements for food products — including without limitation labeling requirements, ingredient lists, health claims, permitted additives, and halal certification — vary significantly across countries and target markets. It is the buyer's responsibility to determine compliance with their target market's regulations. We can provide supporting documentation (certificates, test reports) upon request. Statements about halal status or any other dietary status are not intended to substitute for certification by a local religious or regulatory authority.
legal.export_control_desc: All transactions are subject to applicable export control laws and regulations, including without limitation the Customs and Export Administration Regulations of the People's Republic of China and international sanctions regimes. We reserve the right to refuse any order that violates applicable export control laws or sanctions regulations. Buyers are prohibited from re-exporting, diverting, or reselling CandyPro products to sanctioned countries, individuals, or entities.
legal.sanctions_notice: CandyPro does not conduct business with or ship products to countries, individuals, or entities subject to comprehensive sanctions by the UN Security Council, the People's Republic of China, or other applicable jurisdictions. By placing an order, you represent that you are not subject to any such sanctions regime.
